title: Time away
body: Record when you cannot serve for a ministry.
emptyState: No upcoming unavailability recorded for this church.
dialogDescription: Pick the dates you're unavailable to serve.
mirrorBody: Apply the same dates to separate unavailability records—one per ministry you select. This does not create a church-wide absence.
mirrorScope: These ministries will receive mirrored unavailability:
mirrorNoMinistries: You need membership in at least two ministries in this church to mirror dates.
mirrorPartial: {{count}} unavailability records created. These ministries could not be updated: {{failed}}.
mirrorAllFailed: These ministries could not be updated: {{failed}}.
pendingNotice: You have Pending membership in {{ministries}}. You cannot be rostered until Active, but you can still record unavailability for calendar truth.

deleteConfirm.title: Remove unavailability?
deleteConfirm.body: This removes the selected period. You can add it again later if needed.

errors.mirrorMinistriesRequired: Select at least one ministry to mirror.
errors.invalidWindow: End time must be after start time.
errors.summary: Fix the highlighted fields and try again.
